body.usage: Body text, primary numbers in light mode, general UI elements

custom.description: Custom 5x7 SVG dot-matrix number renderer used for huge amounts and prominent statistics, especially in dark mode.

components.StackedCardCarousel: iOS widget style, main card 55% screen width, swipe left/right with spring physics. Dark mode active card has indigo glow.
components.SmartLimitWidget: DotNum 74% center + tiny ghost % either side + solid+dotted hybrid progress line with triangle pointer.
components.GaugeDial: Circular gauge dial, tick marks like speedometer (Insights and Split Detail dark mode).
components.DonutChart: Light mode equivalent for Insight/Split Detail overview.
components.QuickActionsGrid: Row of 4 squares: Add Expense, Settle Up, Scan Bill, Invite.

screens.Login_Register: Centered layout. App name 'Merizo' in Syne 800 large, tagline 'Split smarter. Settle faster.'. Contains email+password inputs, primary Sign In btn, Google ghost btn.
screens.Home: Top bar (avatar + add btn). Greetings. 'YOU ARE OWED' + huge amount (Inter 900 light / DotNum dark). Stacked Carousel. Quick Actions row. Smart Limit widget (Left). Insights/Reminders (Right stacked). Bottom nav.
screens.Category_Select: 2x3 grid (Trip, Food, Home, Friends, Shopping, Bills) with emoji+label+description on dark gradient cards. Includes back arrow and 'What are you splitting?' Syne 700 header.
screens.Create_Split: 3 steps with 1-2-3 indicator. Includes name/dates/dest chips, members chip input (auto-include unsubmitted text), currency+cover image auto-resolved.
screens.Split_Detail: 180px hero image cover, frosted back+settings+share icons. 4 tabs: Overview, Expenses, Members, Settle. Contains FAB +.
screens.Add_Expense: Bottom sheet modal. Name, large centered amount input, currency pill, auto category, paid by chips, split among checkboxes + Select All.
screens.Insights: 'TOTAL SPENT' huge amount, period toggle (Week/Month/All). Gauge dial (dark) / donut (light). Category list with hybrid progress bars.
screens.Profile: Avatar, stats (DotNum dark / Inter 900 light), prominent theme toggle (sun/moon), logout button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use react-native-reanimated for all complex animations including the spring physics on the carousel.
Use react-native-svg to build the 5x7 DotNum component.
Ensure 180px hero images in Split Detail map correctly to auto-resolved cover keywords using provided image_urls.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
